leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply inline styles directly to Vue template elements using the style attribute
Bind dynamic style objects to Vue elements using v-bind:style
Construct computed properties that return style objects for reactive styling
Manipulate style objects with multiple CSS properties in Vue components
Integrate conditional logic within style bindings to control element appearance
Initialize reactive data properties that drive dynamic style changes
Configure style objects with camelCase property names for JavaScript compatibility
